    Selected object

    View in Sky

    Sky view uses the selected observer, not the aircraft’s location. Camera and motion stay off until you enable them there.

    Know what is loaded

    The full globe is a navigation view, not a promise of worldwide aircraft coverage.

    After connecting, the Aircraft switch resumes that same source and area during this visit. Moving the globe does not change the requested area.

    Load an aircraft area

    Choose a region anywhere on Earth. Loading sends these rounded coordinates, radius and your IP address to the selected provider. Panning and zooming send nothing.

    Connect your own permitted receiver

    For whole-network or broader coverage, connect an HTTPS JSON endpoint you own or are allowed to access. It must permit browser CORS. No proxy, cookies, credentials or coordinates are added. Coverage comes from that source and is not independently verified. Responses larger than 32 MiB or 60,000 records are rejected.

    Do not paste passwords or access tokens into the URL. Pressing Connect explicitly contacts this endpoint; it may receive your IP. There is no automatic provider switch.

    Satellite data

    Satellite layer off.

    CelesTrak stations + visual catalogue, propagated with satellite.js SGP4. Geographic subpoints are shown; altitude and symbol size are not to scale. This is not a complete satellite catalogue or a visibility prediction.

    Map & report limits

    Low-resolution coastlines show geography, not roads or borders for navigation. Trails use only received or calculated samples from this session. Aircraft reports expire; missing reports do not establish an empty sky.

    Land: Natural Earth, public domain. Projection: d3-geo (ISC). Aircraft sources are named with each connection.
